llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备NiTi基复合材料的沉淀相和超弹性，虽涉及增材制造和力学测试，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳，与用户关注点关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures for stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, and does not link microstructure to stress shielding in biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM增材制造NiTi基复合材料中Ni4Ti3沉淀相的形成及其对超弹性的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备NiTi基复合材料，通过热处理调控沉淀相，并进行力学性能表征
summary_zh.result: 发现Ni4Ti3沉淀相显著影响超弹性行为，优化热处理可改善形状记忆效应
summary_zh.validation: 通过XRD、SEM和压缩力学测试验证沉淀相和超弹性

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the in-situ formation of Ni4Ti3 precipitates in NiTi-based composites fabricated by selective laser melting and their effect on pseudoelasticity.
summary_en.method: NiTi-based composites were fabricated by selective laser melting, followed by heat treatment to control precipitate formation, and characterized for mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: The presence of Ni4Ti3 precipitates significantly influenced the pseudoelastic behavior, with optimized heat treatment improving shape memory properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using XRD, SEM, and compression mechanical testing to confirm precipitate formation and pseudoelastic response.

papers.title: Titanium plate fabricated by sputter-less selective laser melting
papers.venue: The Japan Society of Applied Physics

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及钛板的选择性激光熔化制造，未涉及应力屏蔽或生物医学应用。
llm.why_not_core: No link to implant biomechanics, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发无溅射的选择性激光熔化工艺制造钛板。
summary_zh.method: 采用特殊的SLM工艺参数制备钛板。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备钛板并测试其力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证工艺可行性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a sputter-less selective laser melting process for fabricating titanium plates.
summary_en.method: Optimized SLM parameters were used to build titanium plates.
summary_en.result: The fabricated plates achieved good mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing confirmed the quality of the plates.
